Made by (주)유니쎌팜 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 210μg of Vitamin A, 0.36mg of Vitamin B1, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 3mg of Zinc, 120μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 210μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 3mg Zinc, 120μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)유니쎌팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin A labelled (210μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.36mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.42mg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.45mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (30mg / 500mg), 80~150%

Folate labelled (120μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Appearance 미황색의 장방형 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 24개월
Storage 고온 다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 210μg of Vitamin A, 0.36mg of Vitamin B1, 0.42mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 2.55mg of Zinc, 120μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 210μg Vitamin A, 0.36mg Vitamin B1, 0.42mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 2.55mg Zinc, 120μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)케이지앤에프

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
